retrievalProfile.description: A rustic outdoor group portrait featuring 1960s fashion and ornate, swash-heavy psychedelic lettering centered at the top.
triggerTerms: vintage band portrait in rural setting

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five individuals in late-1960s attire (paisley, bell-bottoms, fringe) posed around a weathered wooden shed in a sunlit rural field, topped with a distinctive green psychedelic logo.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group clustered around a central dark doorway
Bright green typography contrasting against dark wood
Warm earth tones of the foreground vs. cool greens of the background
Natural sunlight creating harsh shadows on the ground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body group portrait occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central dark opening of the wooden structure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright green logo at top center, moves down through the central figure, and fans out to the peripheral members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky and distant hills on the right side provide breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans (wood, dirt, clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep shadows and dark interior of the shed
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant lime green for the primary logo
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, naturalistic saturation for the photo with high-saturation, flat-color typography.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon colors except for the logo

letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated swashes and curls on ascenders and descenders
Variable stroke width with thick verticals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' features a large top loop and a sweeping bottom tail
The 'h' has a descender that curls back under the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative face paired with minimal, small-scale technical metadata in the corners.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, flowing curves of the custom lettering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a 1960s folk-rock band (men and women) in paisley and brown clothing, posed in front of a weathered wooden outhouse in a sunny field with distant hills. High-noon lighting with sharp shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, lime green custom-lettered logo at the top center using a psychedelic serif style with heavy swashes and curls.

verificationChecks: Is the green logo the most vibrant element?
Is the wood texture of the shed visible and weathered?
Is the typography centered and ornate?

adjustableVariables: Specific green hue of the logo

avoid: Perfectly straight digital lines in the logo

postGenerationChecks: Verify the logo has a hand-drawn, swash-heavy quality
Ensure the lighting feels like natural outdoor sun
Confirm the color palette is dominated by earth tones and lime green
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Band Portrait + Weathered Wood + Psychedelic Swash Typography
